sutta: Discourses and other works preserved in five collections.
digha-nikaya: Long discourses covering teachings, practice, and discussions.
majjhima-nikaya: Middle-length discourses on teachings and practice.
samyutta-nikaya: Discourses grouped by topic or by the people involved.
anguttara-nikaya: Discourses arranged around numbered sets of teachings.
khuddaka-nikaya: A varied collection of short texts, verses, and other works; its extent varies by edition.
khuddaka-nikaya/khuddakapatha: Short passages for recitation and basic instruction.
khuddaka-nikaya/dhammapada: Verses on conduct, practice, and wisdom.
khuddaka-nikaya/udana: Inspired utterances with accounts of their occasions.
khuddaka-nikaya/itivuttaka: Short teachings combining prose and verse.
khuddaka-nikaya/vimanavatthu: Verses about heavenly rebirth and the actions leading to it.
khuddaka-nikaya/petavatthu: Verses about departed beings and the consequences of actions.
khuddaka-nikaya/theragatha: Verses attributed to early Buddhist monks.
khuddaka-nikaya/therigatha: Verses attributed to early Buddhist nuns.
khuddaka-nikaya/jataka: Canonical verses about the Buddha’s previous lives, preserved with their traditional commentary stories in a complete six-volume English translation.
khuddaka-nikaya/niddesa: Explanations of parts of the Suttanipāta.
khuddaka-nikaya/patisambhidamagga: Analyses of knowledge and the path of practice.
khuddaka-nikaya/apadana: Verse accounts of past deeds associated with monks and nuns.
khuddaka-nikaya/buddhavamsa: Accounts of earlier Buddhas and the bodhisatta’s aspirations.
khuddaka-nikaya/cariyapitaka: Verse accounts illustrating the bodhisatta’s conduct.
khuddaka-nikaya/milindapanha: A dialogue text included in some Theravāda editions; the separate SuttaCentral/Kelly segment alignment remains incomplete.
khuddaka-nikaya/nettipakarana: A work on methods for interpreting and explaining the Buddha’s teaching; included in some Theravāda editions.
khuddaka-nikaya/petakopadesa: A work on interpreting and organizing the Buddha’s teaching; included in some Theravāda editions.

khuddaka-nikaya/khuddakapatha.title: The Minor Readings and The Illustrator of Ultimate Meaning
khuddaka-nikaya/khuddakapatha.edition: Pali Text Society, translation first published 1960; 2005 reprint
khuddaka-nikaya/khuddakapatha.description: Complete English translation of Khuddakapāṭha with its traditional commentary.
khuddaka-nikaya/khuddakapatha.scope: Complete 387-page book: all nine Khuddakapāṭha readings and the full Illustrator of Ultimate Meaning commentary, with introductions and indexes.
khuddaka-nikaya/khuddakapatha.format_note: The source is preserved as one complete PDF. It contains an OCR text layer, but the OCR has visible recognition errors; no unverified transcript is published.
khuddaka-nikaya/khuddakapatha.print_notice_note: The scan retains its original all-rights-reserved notice. The current PTS copyright page lists this title under CC BY-NC 4.0.

khuddaka-nikaya/petakopadesa.title: The Piṭaka-Disclosure (Peṭakopadesa)
khuddaka-nikaya/petakopadesa.scope: Complete English text in all nine SuttaCentral sections Pe 1–9, matched to all nine Pali text IDs, plus the 223-page scan of the printed edition through page 402, including all eight divisions, indexes, glossary, and appendix.
khuddaka-nikaya/petakopadesa.format_note: SuttaCentral labels this electronic translation unproofread. The nine source HTML pages are preserved; PTS page-reference labels are hidden in the reading text. Pe 7 continues into Pe 8. The section texts are not aligned line by line to Pali. The companion PDF is an image-only PDF scan with no searchable text layer.
khuddaka-nikaya/petakopadesa.print_notice_note: The scan retains its original printed notice; the Pali Text Society now licenses this translation under CC BY-NC 4.0.
khuddaka-nikaya/petakopadesa.download_label: complete English text and scan (TXT + PDF)

khuddaka-nikaya/milindapanha.description: A complete two-volume English translation of the seven-book Milindapañha edition translated from Pali by T. W. Rhys Davids.
khuddaka-nikaya/milindapanha.collection_note: This is a complete historical English edition, not a segment-aligned translation; the separate SuttaCentral/Kelly alignment remains incomplete.
khuddaka-nikaya/milindapanha.rights_note: The 1890 and 1894 editions are public domain in the United States. The scans preserve the original books; source and public-domain records are linked below.
khuddaka-nikaya/milindapanha.scope: Complete two-volume translation of Books I–VII, including introductions, appendixes, and indexes. It is preserved as whole books and is not aligned segment by segment to the site's Pali text.
khuddaka-nikaya/milindapanha.format_note: Both original scanned volumes are provided intact. Their OCR text layers are not republished as transcripts.
khuddaka-nikaya/milindapanha.print_notice_note: The two original volumes retain their 1890 and 1894 printed notices; the scans are identified as public domain in the United States by the linked records.
khuddaka-nikaya/milindapanha.source_note: Internet Archive scans of the Clarendon Press editions.
khuddaka-nikaya/milindapanha.license: Public domain in the United States
